Name: MENU_PARAM_COLOR_TABLE_ST
Description: Colour palettes of Elden Ring's character-creation colour pickers. NR has no character creator, but its menu code still has the colour picker that reads this param; whether any NR menu opens it is not established. Retail: the 118 Elden Ring rows, unchanged.

Fields.Name: Gradient Mode
Fields.Description: How the column's 11 shades (top to bottom) are made. 1: shade 1 is point 1, shade 6 point 2 and shade 11 point 3, with even blends between. 0 or other: every shade is the default colour.

Fields.Name: Hue
Fields.Description: Hue in degrees (wraps at 360), shared by every shade of the column.

Fields.Name: Saturation [3]
Fields.Description: Saturation of point 3 (0 to 1). Used only by Gradient Mode 1.

Fields.Name: Brightness [3]
Fields.Description: Brightness (HSV value) of point 3 (0 to 1). Used only by Gradient Mode 1.
